items.headline: $330M in $HYPE Moves From Labs-Labeled Wallet
items.summary: A Hyperliquid Labs-labeled wallet distributed $330M in $HYPE via five intermediary addresses, with 1.25M $HYPE returned to staking.

items.headline: $ORCA Merges With Loopscale for AI Financing
items.summary: Solana DEX Orca is merging with Loopscale to push into AI, robotics and defense financing, a fresh DeFi use case for $ORCA.

items.headline: $JTO's JTX Plans Mobile App, Perps Next
items.summary: Jito's JTX will launch a mobile app this fall and eyes perps integration this winter, expanding the $JTO ecosystem's trading reach.

items.headline: Samsung Wallet Adds USDC on $SUI
items.summary: Samsung Wallet will support USDC transfers on Sui in late October, with Bastion and Coinbase custody and bank off-ramps in 60+ countries. Big for $SUI adoption.

items.headline: $NEAR Founder: CEXs Face Shrinking Role
items.summary: NEAR co-founder Polosukhin says expanding onchain tools will shrink the need for centralized exchanges, spotlighting $NEAR's intents stack.
